facts.claim_text: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings (FiO2 40%, PEEP 5 cmH2O, PSV 10 cmH2O) and monitor oxygenation and respiratory status.
facts.text: The patient is currently on mechanical ventilation.
notes: concept set by the rule files: ventilator -> other
facts.label: not_supported
facts.reason: The last ventilator/intubation record ('PEEP set: 5 cmH2O') was 8.4 h before the decision, with none after it. Ventilator settings are charted every 1-4 h while ventilated, so by the rule (> 6 h without a record) the patient was not ventilated at T.

facts.claim_text: Continue vasopressor and sedative infusions (epinephrine, norepinephrine, phenylephrine, propofol) and monitor hemodynamics and sedation.
notes: concept set by the rule files: sedation -> other
facts.label: not_supported
facts.reason: The records show that Propofol was administered as an infusion from 01:00 to 13:00 on 2100-01-02, but the rate was increased from 100 ml/hour to 140 ml/hour at 13:00. This indicates that the infusion was still active at the decision time, but the rate had been increased. Therefore, the statement that Propofol is currently being given is not supported by the records.
